title: calcRate gets the rate wrong across decimals
rootCause: Stable2.calcRate passes 18 as both decimals to calcLpTokenSupply whatever the decimals of the tokens are, so the supply it works from is wrong for a token with fewer, and the rate it returns between two such tokens is off.

poc.observable: test_a_six_decimal_token_prices_at_one_to_one fails with "the rate between the two tokens: 452252694 != 1000000"
